column1: # objects.csv — maps Vista alarm_object (column 2 of $this.alr) to MainManager MainID.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Unmapped alarm objects fall back to mainmanager.default_main_id from config.json.
# Note: alarm_object includes the suffix (_AH for high-alarm
# _A for generic). Map each point you want separately. Same sensor with _AH
# and _AL can point to the same MainID or different ones.
